name: journey 13: re-indent a minified file (preview the indented text, fold it, write it indented from the original view, back to the edited view, quit)

notes.note: e, ctrl+o to the recent files, enter opens the newest: orders.min.json, one long line
tab through the views (fields, flat) to JSON: the indented text it will write
j, z c folds the data array: the whole file is two keys
G to the end: the page object closes the file
g g back to the top, ctrl+w h to the tree
T: the original document, exactly as read (the edited view would write the restructured document)
w writes the shown document; the chooser opens on the recent files, alt+o steps back to browsing the file's folder
type a new name, enter: written indented, a new file beside the source
T back to the edited view: nothing was edited, so nothing asks on the way out
